description: Use before naming a product, company or project. For 1-3 names: domain availability via registry RDAP (DNS fallback), handles on GitHub, Bluesky, npm, PyPI, Telegram (others flagged could_not_confirm with links), exact-name Apple App Store apps, and identical/similar USPTO trademarks with serial, registration number and status. Per-check UTC timestamps, optional free variations and Markdown report. Not legal advice; nothing is registered.

markdown.description: 1 to add report_markdown: one table per name.

name.description: Name to check, or up to 3 comma-separated names.

platforms.description: Comma-separated platforms (max 12): github,bluesky,npm,pypi,telegram,mastodon are checked; x,instagram,tiktok,youtube,reddit,twitch,facebook,linkedin return could_not_confirm plus a manual link.

tm.description: Trademark offices: us is searched (default); eu,wipo,se,uk return manual search links.

variations.description: 1 to suggest up to 5 variations free on the first TLD and the first two checked platforms (single name only).

name: brand_check
